name: Dreamplace_benchmarks
description: Benchmarks built around DreamPlace to evaluate VLSI placement algorithms and solvers on real or synthetic netlists. It measures placement quality (wirelength, congestion) and computational performance to compare placement methods. The suite is intended for researchers developing placement optimizers and hardware-aware EDA tools.
reputation: Widely used within the EDA and academic VLSI placement community as a practical, GPU-accelerated benchmarking suite.
